title: Kevin J.S. Duska Jr., chat statement to the Demko agent, 11 Nov 2026
extract: Descent given as: Kevin J.S. Duska Jr. → Kevin John Duska → Stefan Duska → Mihaly Duska and Maria Demko. Maria Demko described as the wife of his father's father's father.
reliability: Family knowledge plus Kevin's own earlier research. No document seen. Names above the father are second-hand at best.

title: Baptism register entry no. 36 of 1882: Mihály, son of György Demkó and Mária Hreskó, Viszoka 132
extract: Born 19 Aug 1882, baptised 20 Aug 1882. Father Greek Catholic farmer, mother Roman Catholic. Godparents Mihály Varga and Anna Hreskó, both Roman Catholic.
reliability: Original record made the day after the birth: strong for the event and the parents. Weak for provenance: parish, denomination and archive reference rest on the file name alone.

type: Authored report (research pass, compiled by a research agent from web sources)
title: Research pass 1 on the Demko surname in Ung county, 12 Nov 2026
extract: Identifies the Greek Catholic priest of Čičarovce in 1882-1886 as Ján Csurgovics and the Roman Catholic priest in 1868-1890 as Andrej (Endre) Polányi; places Vysoká nad Uhom as a Greek Catholic filial of Čičarovce from after 1806 to 1948; gives film numbers for the Čičarovce registers; quotes Act LIII of 1868, section 12; finds no Demko in a private transcription of the 1715 lists for the four villages; finds nothing in North American indexes.
reliability: Secondary throughout: municipal and parish web pages, reference works, a private transcription, catalogue numbers relayed by a finding list. Good for where to look, not for who anyone was. Two statements in it came from the owner's private correspondence and are set aside (DM-DEC-010). The report text is not archived here for that reason; the findings used are in leads DM-L-014 to DM-L-021.

title: Petition of the inhabitants of Pálócz, Tegenye, Viszoka and Mogyorós to the bishop, Tegenye, 27 January 1803
extract: Names Joannes Demko among four men signing for Viszoka.
reliability: Original and contemporary. Names written by the scribe. No archive reference on the images; a location tag in one photo points to Berehove.

title: DUSKA stone: Mary Demko, 1906-1950, wife of Mike Duska
extract: Born 1906, died 1950, beloved wife of Mike Duska.
reliability: Original object. Death year near first-hand; birth year as the family gave it. Cemetery from the file name.

title: Photograph at the DUSKA stone, labelled as the burial of Stefan Duska
extract: Fresh grave at the stone of DM-S-004-2.
reliability: The image shows a recent burial at that stone. Whose burial, and who is present, rests on the file name.

title: Baptism entry no. 44: Mária, daughter of Mihály Demkó, cottar, and Anna, born 24 February, year and parish not shown
extract: A Mária Demkó with a father Mihály, but a different mother and birthday from the 1906 civil record.
reliability: Original entry, but cut so that year, place, residence and godparents are lost.

title: Deed of sale effective 1 November 1966, declarations of the seller
extract: Mike Duska married once, to Maria Demko, who died at Montréal on 9 September 1950.
reliability: Sworn declaration in a notarial act, 16 years after the death, by or for the widower. Strong for the marriage and the death date.

type: State civil register of births (image of the original)
title: Birth registration no. 45 of 1906, Alsókánya: Mária Demkó, born Solymos 22 August 1906
extract: Father Mihály Demkó, Greek Catholic, day-labourer, of Solymos, born Magasrév, aged 24. Mother Mária Kocsis, Greek Catholic, born Solymos, aged 20. Explained in Slovak.
reliability: Original, made the next day, informant the father in person. The strongest record in the file. Custodian and volume not shown.

type: Authored transcription by a third party
title: Transcription of the 1906 birth registration, Word file dated 13 January 2022
extract: Agrees with DM-S-004-6 as read here on all names, ages and dates.
reliability: Derivative of DM-S-004-6 and weaker than the image: two place names doubted, one field skipped.

reliability: Official extract under seal from the parish's own register, with volume and page. Direct evidence that Štefan's mother was Maria Demko of Iňačovce.
